name: Amon-Ra St. Brown

background.fact: Born October 24, 1999; grew up in Anaheim Hills, California. He went to Servite High School as a freshman, then Mater Dei High School in Santa Ana, where as a senior in 2017 he had 72 catches for 1,320 yards and 20 touchdowns, and was a five-star recruit who committed to USC.
At USC he caught 60 passes for 750 yards as a freshman (2018), 77 for 1,042 as a sophomore (2019) and 41 for 478 with seven touchdowns in six games as a junior (2020).
Detroit drafted him in the fourth round (pick 112) of the 2021 draft. He has made the Pro Bowl four times from 2022 to 2025 and was first-team All-Pro in 2023 and 2024.

background.fact: Listed at 6 ft 0 in, 202 lb, age 27, jersey 14, in his sixth NFL season, all with Detroit. Combine: 4.51 forty, 38.5 inch vertical.

family.fact: His mother Miriam (born Steyer) is from Leverkusen, Germany; his father John Brown was a bodybuilder in the 1980s and a two-time amateur Mr. Universe.

He has two brothers: Equanimeous (the oldest, a wide receiver) and Osiris (played college football at Stanford). All three brothers hold dual American and German citizenship. He speaks English, German and French.

scouts_read: St. Brown is questionable with ribs but has been limited all week and played through the same tag last Sunday, so I expect him on the field. Goff has thrown him every target this year, and he is still the main target at about 32 percent. The catch is the scoring: with no point per catch, his yards and touchdowns carry everything, and he has not scored since Week 3. Detroit is a small favorite with a 26 point team total, which fits a normal game of about 8 catches. I would project roughly 11 to 15 points, with a touchdown pushing him past 20 and a rib issue or a slow script dropping him under 8.
